reviewer: second independent reviewer (host parallel CLI execution worker)
passed_meaning: false: native certification is impossible on the LIVE constructor (hidden duplicates). The factory, gate and proposed constructor all pass every check below. Conditional verdict: ready for integration once root applies the proposed constructor.

review_findings.output_leakage: none. solve() takes no demos and no labels; verify() compares labels after execution. The gate reads demo pairs and query INPUTS only, and a test passes a bogus query output and gets the same result.
review_findings.hidden_parameter_inference: none. The factory takes (d4, palette) explicitly and runs no D4 search. The gate takes no d4/palette (accepted for the signature, then ignored). It recovers stem directions, colours and slots from visible grids.
review_findings.rule_specific_hardcoding: none. The 4 canonical corner slots per colour are the task rule and are mapped forward through transformed(). No fixture literals appear (audit_target passes).
review_findings.ambiguous_fallbacks: none in the factory: no first/majority/intersection choice and no demo skipping. Tally clipping at 4 is unreachable within the constructor bounds, and the gate rejects any unobserved prefix. The gate needs every demo-consistent rule to agree on the full query grid.
review_findings.domain_narrowing: none. The proposed fix rejects only exact duplicate (row,col,cdir) latents, which are invisible. Overlapping and touching border bars are kept: in the gated audit, 244/4000 pairs have border runs of 5-9 cells. The explicit/validate path is byte-identical, and the canonical fixture is unchanged.
review_findings.hard_cases: 6000 explicit native latents with border rows over-sampled (runs of 5-12 cells on border rows): the factory is exact on all 6000 under 8 D4 x 2 palettes, and the independent 4-direction exact-cover parse is unique and correct on all 6000.
issues_found_and_fixed: Prior gate (d5c634a2_evidence.gate) worked only in the canonical frame, needed latent_explanations on 0/2 colours, and was not portable to augmented demos. It was replaced by a frame-free visible gate, arc_agi2/t_tally_d5c634a2_evidence.py.

The first version of the new gate gave a rule-enumeration-order-dependent reason string across D4 frames (the decision was the same). It now collects all missing prefixes, so the reason is frame-invariant.
review_findings.remaining_issue: LIVE native constructor labels count invisible exact-duplicate Ts (171/1000 audit-seed pairs). The visible gate catches such demos (demonstrations_fit_no_tally_rule), but it cannot detect a bad QUERY label without reading labels: 37 mismatches in 250 native episodes. Root must apply proposed_constructor.diff before any count is admitted.
